title: Mouse clicks aren*t at the cursor position when windows scaling is not at 100%
author: P7aM5qzEddT66lE
body_snippet:
tasks to reproduce::
change screen scaling to e.g. 125% (System - Bildschirm - Skalierung)


click anywhere into th mremoteng windows. The further the click is away from top-left corner, the greater is the distance bewtween mouse position and actual click.

Using [mRemoteNG-20260222-v1.78.2-NB-3405-x64-SC

comments.author: er2or
comments.snippet:
Follow the advice here https://github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/issues/3298#issuecomment-4395058701 by [fredriks-eltele].

I think #3298 and #3222 are related.

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet:
This looks like the same bug as #3200 and #3261, both reported on NB 3405 and fixed since: #3201 sets the DPI mode at startup and #3446 corrects the click hit-testing at scaling above 100%. Both are in every nightly from NB 3694 (11 September) on.

@P7aM5qzEddT66lE, could you check whether the latest nightly, NB 3782, still has the offset at 125%?
